does_not_apply: other penalties such as cover, range or wind

NgamBanOnDinh.nonstacking: Lv2 replaces Lv1 not additive; does not double-apply same penalty with Phối Hợp Kiếm–Nỏ (which addresses distinct switch-only penalty).

PhoiHopKiemNo.name: Phối Hợp Kiếm–Nỏ
PhoiHopKiemNo.valid_transition: Legally completed sword sheathing -> Liên Nỏ Hắc Nha switching and properly loaded/ready for normally timed aimed shot
PhoiHopKiemNo.effect: After legally securing sword and changing to ready/loaded Liên Nỏ, reduce by at most 10 percentage points only actual hit penalty due to this weapon switch on immediate legally timed aimed shot, floor remaining switch penalty at zero. Lv2 REPLACES Lv1 5pp, not additive.
does_not_apply: Free attack or shot out of turn
Damage bonus or reload speed bonus
PhoiHopKiemNo.stacking_guard: Separately Ngắm Bắn Ổn Định Lv2 addresses only actual movement-specific hit penalty up to15pp after <=3m move, full stop and valid aimed shot. Never apply both to a single penalty.
PhoiHopKiemNo.verified_training: T170 Maela's six multibeat loaded/unloaded crossbow sequences: 1 pass loaded, 2 fail premature trigger on unloaded (no shot), 3 pass loaded, 4 pass properly reloaded, 5 pass loaded, 6 pass properly reloaded; 5/6 meets >=5/6 threshold.
